title: SAGE-Kit Transition Resolution Error v1
description: A closed, language-neutral failure envelope limited to 1048576 canonical bytes under contract.json and strictly mutually exclusive with Transition Resolution Result v1. It contains 1 through 100 bounded deterministic issues. Invalid or oversized input, binding mismatch, invalid Node Result, illegal transition, invalid authority-change status, or oversized would-be Result returns Error with no partial Result, no transition, and no fabricated HANDOFF or BLOCKED substitute. Error contains no private reasoning, transcript, stdout, stderr, secret, credential, environment dump, runtime event, state mutation, Graph mutation, or authority grant.

issues.description: Bounded deterministic issues only. No issue may carry a payload, output, transcript, traceback, secret, credential, or environment data.

path.description: Bounded language-neutral instance path rooted at $, never a local filesystem path.

message.description: Bounded observable message without private reasoning, output, transcript, or sensitive data.
